string.name: permanentlyDeleteRound
string.comment:
Refers to live tournaments being broadcast on Lichess (https://lichess.org/broadcast).
Description (also translateable): Delete all games of this round. The source will need to be active in order to re-create them. This string has been amended since its initial publication; it didn't say "all its games" at the time.

Uşbu turning barça öyinlarini öçirib taşlaş. Ularni qayta tiklaş uçun manba faol holatda bölişi lozim.

resources.string: Uşbu turnir va undagi barça turlar va öyinlar butunlay öçirib taşlansinmi?
Öyin natijalari asosida öyinçilarning oçkolarini körsatiş
Ixtiyoriy: öyinçilar ismlari, reytinglari va unvonlarini özgartiriş
Turlar boşlanişidan xabardor böliş uçun obuna böling. Bildirişnomalarni akkaunt sozlamalaridan boşqariş mumkin.
Hozirça taxtalar yöq. Öyinlar yuklangaç, ular şu yerda körinadi.
Hali öyinçilar yöq. Öyinlar yuklangaç, ular paydo böladi.
Taxtalarni manba yoki %s orqali yuklaş mumkin
Turnir jadvali translyatsiya qilingan öyinlar yordamida hisoblanadi va rasmiy natijalardan farq qilişi mumkin.
Natijalarni yaşirişni tanlaganingiz sababli spoiler bermaslik uçun barça obzor taxtalari böş.
Quyidagi atama(lar) avtomatik tarzda tarjima qilinadi: %s.
Birlamçi nomni saqlasangiz, avtomatik tarzda boşqa tillarga tarjima qilinadi.

string.name: underXAgeTournament
string.comment: %s is the maximum age set by the organiser for a tournament. e.g. 'U18' will mean it is an tournament for under-18 years. Please use your language's conventions in sporting activities for how the 'U' should be translated and keep it short.

string.name: underXEloTournament
string.comment: %s is the maximum Elo rating set by the organiser for a tournament. e.g. 'U2000' will mean it is an tournament for players with Elo under 2000. Please use your language's conventions in sporting activities for how the 'U' should be translated and keep it short.
